title: cobblemon_omega
description: cobblemon but with more stuff so it feels fun and stuff but it has less stuff than cobbleverse and has weather and seasons and extra stuff but isn't solely based on pokemon adventure like cobbleverse. idk i just wanna play this stuff w my girlfriend
body:
cobblemon but now it has:
- seasons
- extra biomes (and wood!) via terralith, terrestria, and overhauled overworld
- mega showdown
- all pokemon
- custom megas
- custom eeveelutions for the other types
- glow trims!!
- extra building blocks, a lot more (via paladin's furniture)

however this modpack DOES add extra starters so be careful. i'll probably add a version that doesn't do extra starters, but hopefully it isn't too much for anybody. oh also it has tectonic.

this modpack is for anybody like me who wants more than base cobblemon but still wants to play minecraft and stuff and not focus on the pokemon journey like cobbleverse. no shade to both tho they're the best.

i might add extra versions cause maybe it's too much that's been added, dunno will decide

and credit goes to every talented person who made all the mods i've just borrowed :))
